title: Interpolation between first and second moments
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $f\colon\{0,1\}^n\to\mathbb R$, and let $t\in\mathbb R$ satisfy $1<t<2$. With expectation taken under the uniform measure on the Boolean cube, $$\E[|f|^t]\leq \E[|f|]^{2-t}\E[f^2]^{t-1}.$$
replaced: Let $n\ge0$ and give $\{0,1\}^n$ uniform probability; write $\mathbb E$ for expectation. For every real cube function $f$ and real $1<t<2$, $\mathbb E|f|^t\le(\mathbb E|f|)^{2-t}(\mathbb E[f^2])^{t-1}$.
